phase_model.description: Resolved subagent model routing for one fan-out phase. `tier` is the portable tier the host resolved per docs/model-overrides.md; `model` is the concrete host model it spawned with. Local/observability only.

model.description: Concrete host model the phase spawned with (e.g. 'sonnet', 'opus', 'gpt-6.1-sol'). When a phase ran on several routes, the models joined by `, ` in route order. Omitted when tier resolved to 'inherit' and the host did not name the parent-session model.

completed_at.description: Written by scripts/write_terminal_metric.sh at Step 5, before the metric append. scripts/state_init.sh reinitializes a state file, for this PR or another, only when this is present; a terminal `status` alone can be a pre-Step-5 scope-split record that must resume.

dry_run.description: Resolved dry_run mode for this loop. Persisted at init so a mid-iteration resume honors it rather than re-parsing the default. Absent means false: dry_run had no runtime effect before it was wired, so a state file without this field is a normal run.

pr_scope.description: Optional record of the PR-scope check from Step 3.5. Absent when pr_scope=false or when the loop predates this field.

excluded_paths.description: Paths that count_new_loc.sh excluded from the new-LOC total (lock files, generated code, snapshots, vendor, build output, binary diffs). Surfaced to the gate agent as context.

agent_errors.description: Errors of scope agents that failed to return a valid recommendation, recorded beside any valid one. See docs/pr-scope.md.

shallow_adversary_runs.description: Loop-scoped count of forced-adversary runs on the blockers>0 path (see SKILL.md §4d.0). Capped (see maximum on this field). Optional for backward compat with state files predating this field; treat absence as 0.

shallow_approval_adversary_runs.description: legacy field, retained for reading historical state. new runs do not write it.

comment_ledger.description: top-level, loop-scoped latest successful inline disposition per thread root. append-history atomically upserts fresh reply receipts with the original reviewed history snapshot. only inline review comments enter here; reply_pr_comments.sh owns cross-run idempotency. absence means [] for backward compatibility. see docs/comment-handling.md.

head_sha_after.description: Head SHA after this iteration's commit, equal to head_sha_before on the no-commit paths. Required: §4h passes history[-1].head_sha_after to safe_push.sh as the expected remote head, and resume compares current_head against it (docs/resume.md).

source_reviewers.description: Every persona that raised this finding: §4c unions the list when two surface the same issue, and the §4d.0.5 adversary merge adds "adversary" to a matched panel finding. Persist it whenever synthesis produced one. Optional only for backward compatibility with states written before it existed: scripts/collect_open_findings.py reads it as the finding's owner set, and with the singular `reviewer` alone a finding two personas raised looks like one persona's, so either of them going quiet retires it from the Step 5 open sets.

promotion_reason.description: Optional on read for backward compat with PR #5 state files. promote_findings.py always populates on writes. See SKILL.md §4d.0.5.

source_reviewers.description: Personas whose findings matched and triggered the promotion. For adversary-endorsed promotion this is the adversary plus any panel personas whose suggestion was endorsed.

promotion_reason.description: Optional on read for backward compat with PR #5 state files. promote_findings.py always populates on writes. See SKILL.md §4d.0.5.

ci_failed_checks.description: Failed check names from this iteration's ci_wait.sh visit. Required and non-empty when ci_status is "failure": §4d.1's CI_STUCK rule compares this iteration's names against the most recent earlier failure entry, so a failure entry that records none lets a permanently-red check keep looping. Optional on every other status.

reviewer_errors.description: reviewer subagents whose response was missing, timed out, malformed, or failed schema or dispatched-identity validation this iteration.

reviewers_completed.description: personas whose response passed schema and dispatched-identity validation for this iteration. absent legacy receipts cannot establish completion.

shallow_review.description: Names of reviewers that returned approve with no/empty evidence this iteration (SKILL.md §4c). Omit when empty.

demoted.description: Findings synthesis dropped or demoted this iteration. Read by scripts/promote_findings.py to detect panelist objection in the §4d.0.5 solo-adversary gate. Backward compat: absence is treated as []. See SKILL.md §4c and §4d.0.5.

reason.description: `not_a_problem`: finding was dropped entirely. `synthesis_demoted`: blocker was downgraded to suggestion OR to nit. The §4d.0.5 evidence-gated solo-adversary gate treats either as an objection within ±5 lines.

adversary.description: Adversary persona's output for this iteration, when it ran. Mirrors a reviewer record. Omit when the adversary did not run.

shallow_blocker.description: legacy field, retained for reading historical state. new runs do not write it.

adversary_error.description: Set when the adversary errored or returned schema-invalid output. Mutually exclusive with `adversary`.

adversary_shallow_giveup.description: legacy field, retained for reading historical state. new runs do not write it.

human_comments.description: original complete external-comment snapshot reviewed in this iteration. on replying paths it is atomically recorded with fresh inline dispositions. review_threads retains normalized resolved-thread roots and replies even though review_comments omits resolved inline content. marker comments are filtered. incomplete record-only paths omit this field. see docs/comment-handling.md.

panel_selection.description: Initial §4a.1 panel selection for this iteration, written from scripts/select_panel.py output before any later forced full-panel rerun. `mode` describes that initial selection only; if additional personas ran later via the pre-approval full sweep, `forced_full_sweep` records that path. See docs/delta-gate.md.

forced_full_sweep.description: true when this iteration ran a forced full-panel sweep before §4d.0 because the delta-gated panel reached blockers==0 with personas skipped. See docs/delta-gate.md.

model_routing.description: Resolved subagent model routing for the fan-out phases that ran this iteration. Recorded by the host after it resolves each phase's tier per docs/model-overrides.md and spawns it; only phases that actually ran appear. Local/observability only, never posted to the PR. Optional; absence (of the object or of any phase key) means 'not recorded' and must never block the loop. See docs/model-overrides.md#observability-and-recording.
